summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard and Japan Coast Guard conducted an anti-piracy drill in Manila Bay, while the United States and the Philippines carried out their 16th bilateral maritime exercise in the West Philippine Sea. The PCG opened an upgraded station on Pag-asa Island and monitored several Chinese naval assets near Scarborough Shoal, after Chinese envoy Jing Quan warned China could easily win a conflict with the Philippines, prompting PCG Rear Admiral Jay Tarriela to label the remark a direct threat. The PCG also rescued four people, including a child, stranded on Hagonoy Island in Surigao del Sur. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Filippinenes kystvakt og Japans kystvakt gjennomførte en anti-piratøvelse i Manila Bay, mens USA og Filippinene utførte sin 16. bilaterale maritime øvelse i Vestfilippinene. PCG åpnet en oppgradert stasjon på Pag-asa-øya og overvåket flere kinesiske marineenheter nær Scarborough-skorpen, etter at den kinesiske ambassadøren Jing Quan advarte om at Kina lett kunne vinne en konflikt med Filippinene, noe som fikk PCG-rearadmiral Jay Tarriela til å betegne bemerkningen som en direkte trussel. PCG reddet også fire personer, inkludert et barn, som var strandet på Hagonoy-øya i Surigao del Sur. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
